overview: Chooses whether text sits at the start, middle, or end of its space.

Left.simple: Places text at the start of the line. For English, that means the left edge.
Left.technical: Unreal uses leading alignment for the text flow direction. The game's sequencer additionally sets the containing canvas slot's horizontal alignment pivot to 0.0 for this value.

Center.simple: Centers the text, regardless of which direction the language reads.
Center.technical: Unreal centers the text in its allotted width. The game's sequencer sets the containing canvas slot's horizontal alignment pivot to 0.5.

Right.simple: Places text at the end of the line. For English, that means the right edge.
Right.technical: Unreal uses trailing alignment for the text flow direction. The game's sequencer additionally sets the containing canvas slot's horizontal alignment pivot to 1.0 for this value.

notes: CreditDataTable declares this type. The traced canvas alignment comes from the sequencer text section, which stores its own justification value.
